tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description:
Full details of a hotel: description, amenities, photos, location, rooms, check-in times,
        children policy and payment terms (hotel_code not needed on a hotel's own connector).

tools.name: check_rate
tools.description: Re-check price and availability of an option right before booking.

tools.name: book_hotel
tools.description:
Confirm a booking. Only call after the traveller has explicitly confirmed the hotel, dates, room,
        total price, cancellation policy and payment terms (set traveller_confirmed=true). Payment is
        collected by the property: never ask for card details. Returns the booking reference.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Look up a booking made through iQuota, using its reference and the guest email.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description:
Cancel a booking. First call with confirm=false to get the cancellation fee, tell the traveller,
        and only if they agree call again with confirm=true.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking · Public sink: get_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking · Public sink: get_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
